purpose: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next for agentic coding: four native 262,144-token slots (1,048,576 total), NVFP4 experts, PLE table read in place from NVMe, MTP k=3, fp8 KV, prefix cache, decode CUDA graphs. Optional engine (switch alias qwen38fn); qwen38-1m stays the default. Images on (4 per prompt), video off.

status.basis: Candidate 5 (results/qwen38fn-gates/qualify-2026-10-11-c4/) qualified this launch text-only. Candidate 7 (images on under the owner's 8 GiB floor) failed on NVRM lines at the KV arena (results/qwen38fn-gates/qualify-2026-10-11-c7/). Candidate 8 added the host page-cache release and passed every clause except the soak, which the kit held to 35_soak.py's 12 GiB default (results/qwen38fn-gates/qualify-2026-10-11-c8/). Candidate 9 holds the soak to the profile's 8 GiB floor and is pending its preregistered gate: results/qwen38fn-gates/qualify-2026-10-11-c9/.

safety.note: 8 GiB whole-host floor: owner decision 2026-10-11 to keep 1M with images on (DeepSeek's 1M-fast profile set the 8 GiB precedent); AGENTS.md's 1M gate asks 10. minimum_start_gib is the switch's only admission: candidate 5 used up to 102.97 GiB text-only and images add 3.1-3.3 GiB (results/qwen38fn-gates/diag-vision-2026-10-11), so 115 = the quiet host's 115.2-115.6 GiB, and candidate 7 must measure peak + 8 <= 115. cgroup MemoryCurrent is blind to CUDA unified memory on GB10; the external memwatch is the real guard. The PLE table's page cache is clean and file-backed (reclaimable). MemAvailable admission cannot see another engine's cached model files; HostCacheReleaseWorker drops the model root's page cache before the weights load and again before the KV arena, and refuses the arena unless MemFree covers it plus 2 GiB (candidate 7 met it at MemFree 10.2 GiB).

memory_model.basis: Sized from the 2026-10-11 diagnostic smoke (results/qwen38fn-gates/smoke-2026-10-11). Every logged KV usage reading is a whole number of blocks over 91, so its 4,200,000,000-byte arena held 92 blocks (<= 45,652,174 bytes each), and 194,493 tokens at --max-model-len 131,072 means a request reserves 62 blocks: one group grows by cdiv(L, 3200) (41) and 21 are GDN state (4 groups x 5) plus the QSA ring (1). A 262,144-token slot reserves 103 blocks; four need 412, plus the BlockPool null block and 2 x 4 transient prefill blocks (the smoke held 36 blocks for a 32-block reservation): 421 blocks <= 19,219,565,254 bytes. The fixed 19.22 GB arena (--kv-cache-memory-bytes, 17.90 GiB) is extra_gib. resident_weights_gib + overhead_gib = 84.2 GiB is the measured non-KV footprint (MemAvailable 112.38 -> 25.73 GiB plus 1.44 GiB pushed to swap, less the 3.91 GiB arena; vLLM reported 75.67 GiB of weights). Projected idle on a quiet 114 GiB host: ~11.9 GiB, above the 10 GiB floor with little room; the direct 1M fill needs a quiet host. vLLM's startup log must show >= 1,048,576 tokens at 262,144. Measured 2026-10-11 (results/qwen38fn-gates/diag-drafter-2026-10-11, arm C: drafter FP8 MoE off DeepGEMM, checkpoint page cache evicted during startup): vLLM reported 1,079,117 tokens at 262,144; idle 13.9 GiB from a 115.2 GiB quiet start (101.3 GiB used vs 102.2 GiB modeled); 0 NVRM lines. Images on (candidate 7): vLLM reported 76.49 GiB of weights (vision tower 897,862,112 BF16 bytes), and the diagnostic (results/qwen38fn-gates/diag-vision-2026-10-11) measured 1.2-1.5 GiB more CPU anon and about 1.0 GiB of GPU allocator growth over 100 images. That run had --mm-processor-cache-gb 0, and so does this profile: vLLM's default 4 GiB cache, held in both the API server and the engine core, would add up to 8 GiB this model does not count. overhead_gib 11.3 makes weights + overhead + extra = 106.3 GiB, candidate 5's 102.97 GiB peak plus 3.3 GiB.

qualification_options.note: soak_mem_floor_gib: the owner-set 8 GiB floor (2026-10-11) also holds the soak; 35_soak.py's 12 GiB default failed candidate 8's soak at 9.92 GiB (results/qwen38fn-gates/qualify-2026-10-11-c8).

qualification_targets.note: qwen38-1m README row (results/qwen38-gates/speed-2026-08-18, accuracy-2026-08-18); Flash-Next must match or beat these to replace or complement the default. Speed targets are general, misses are reported.
